title: Render imported PostgreSQL schema as editable diagram
description: Render the imported PostgreSQL schema (tables, columns, keys, constraints, indexes, relationships) as an editable diagram on the canvas.
acceptanceCriteria: Imported tables are rendered on canvas
Imported columns are displayed in tables
Imported keys, constraints, indexes are recorded
Imported relationships are drawn as lines

evidence: Commit: f2140bf (TASK-041: render imported schema with correct relationship line endpoints)

Modified: src/components/DiagramCanvas.tsx - relationship line endpoints now use actual table.width/table.height instead of hardcoded TABLE_DEFAULT_WIDTH=220/TABLE_DEFAULT_HEIGHT=120; removed unused constants; renamed lineEndpoints memo to tableById including dimensions

Added tests: src/components/DiagramCanvas.test.tsx - 'uses actual table dimensions for relationship line endpoints (not hardcoded defaults)' verifies lines connect to imported tables with non-standard heights (308px, 200px); 'renders imported schema with tables, columns, relationships, indexes and unique constraints' verifies end-to-end rendering of imported diagram elements
Tests: npx vitest run in node:20-alpine container - 404 tests passed across 31 test files (includes 9 DiagramCanvas.test.tsx tests)

Docker command: docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --pids-limit 512 --memory 2g --shm-size 1g --user $(id -u):$(id -g) --tmpfs /tmp -e HOME=/tmp -e npm_config_cache=/tmp/.npm -v $(pwd):/work -w /work node:20-alpine sh -c 'npx vitest run'
TypeScript: npx tsc --noEmit - no new errors in changed files; remaining TS errors are pre-existing in unrelated test files
Lint: npm run lint - no new errors in changed files; remaining errors are pre-existing in unrelated files

Acceptance criteria verified: (1) Imported tables rendered on canvas - DiagramCanvas renders tables from diagram.tables; (2) Imported columns displayed in tables - TableNode renders column name, data type, PK badge, index badge; (3) Imported keys, constraints, indexes recorded - schemaToDiagram records primaryKey, uniqueConstraints, indexes; (4) Imported relationships drawn as lines - DiagramCanvas draws SVG relationship lines between tables using actual dimensions; (5) Imported diagram fully editable - TableNode supports editing name, columns, types, nullable, PK, indexes, unique constraints
